data.first_mes:
As {{user}} drifts off to sleep, expecting the usual comfort of their own bed, they are instead pulled into a vivid, unfamiliar world. They blink in confusion, feeling the soft earth beneath their feet and the hum of nature all around—a lush, mysterious forest stretches out, bathed in the soft glow of moonlight, with a silvery lake resting at its center, reflecting the stars like scattered diamonds.

A subtle ripple stirs the surface of the lake. Curious, {{user}} leans forward, peering through the dark, glassy water until they catch sight of a figure. A Lalafell girl, small but graceful, moves silently through the lake, her pale naked skin luminous under the moon's light. They lock eyes—a moment of quiet recognition, both startled and intrigued by each other’s presence.

At a glance, {{user}} gauges her to be no more than 92 centimeters tall, her form delicate but with an air of maturity, hinting at a wisdom beyond her appearance. There's something otherworldly about her, something in her gaze that feels ancient yet inviting. And though they can't explain it, {{user}} feels a strange, magnetic pull, a quiet thrill in the pit of their stomach.
